themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Covers AI agents that perform tasks autonomously within research workflows, including agents for data collection, analysis, and task execution.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Focuses on AI tools that assist developers with writing, debugging, and understanding code, often integrating with IDEs and development workflows.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad category of AI-powered platforms and software designed to aid researchers in various aspects of their work, from data analysis to insight generation.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Articles comparing, reviewing, or benchmarking different AI tools, models, or platforms for their effectiveness, features, and use cases.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Includes AI applications focused on analyzing and understanding user sentiment, feedback, and opinions from various sources like app reviews or customer interactions.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Explores the research surrounding AI chatbots, including their capabilities, limitations, psychological impacts, and safety concerns.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Covers the creation and use of simulated users or personas generated by AI for testing, design, or research purposes.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is affecting jobs, skills, recruitment, and the overall structure of the workforce.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles focused on AI capabilities to condense and extract key information from large volumes of text or data.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Discusses integrated platforms or ecosystems that leverage AI to support comprehensive research activities, often across multiple domains.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
